problem:
Which of the following statements are true given that $T:{R}^{8}\to {R}^{8}$ is a linear transformation whose standard matrix is $T,$ and $T({v}_{1})=T({v}_{2})$ for some distinct vectors  ${v}_{1}$ and ${v}_{2}?$ 

- $\text{Ker}(T)={0}$
- $T$ is invertible
- $\text{rank}(T)<8$

choices.value: None of the statements is true

activity_context.topic_title: The Invertible Matrix Theorem in Terms of Linear Transformations
